q: What is HighLevel?
expected: An all-in-one white-label sales and marketing platform for agencies and their clients.

q: What is a sub-account?
expected: A per-client workspace (also called a Location) holding that client's contacts, calendars, funnels, workflows, and conversations.

q: What is the maximum CSV import size for contacts?
expected: 50,000 rows per file; larger lists must be split.

q: What are custom values used for?
expected: Account-level mail-merge placeholders like {{custom_values.support_phone}} substituted into emails, SMS, and funnels at send time.

q: What is a Smart List?
expected: A saved, filtered view of contacts.

q: What can a workflow do besides simple actions?
expected: Supports if/else branches, wait steps, and goal events that let a contact skip ahead.

q: What are the four calendar types?
expected: Round-robin, collective, class booking, and service calendars.

q: What is a collective calendar?
expectedContains: all chosen team members are free
expected: It books a slot only when all chosen team members are free.

q: What must I register before sending SMS to US numbers?
expected: A2P 10DLC registration is required before sending SMS to US numbers.

q: What DNS records are needed for email deliverability?
expected: SPF and DKIM records must authenticate the dedicated sending domain.

q: Which channels appear in the unified inbox?
expected: SMS, email, WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger, Instagram DMs, and Google Business Messages.

q: How does reputation management collect reviews?
expected: It requests reviews over SMS and email and aggregates reviews from Google Business Profile and Facebook.

q: What is text-to-pay?
expected: A feature that sends a payment link over SMS.

q: What is the LeadConnector app?
expected: The mobile app (iOS and Android) giving inbox, calendar, contacts, and payments on the go.

q: How much is the Starter plan and how many sub-accounts does it allow?
expected: $97 per month, allowing up to three sub-accounts.

q: What discount do you get for paying annually?
expected: Annual billing gives two months free.

q: How can I clone my setup to a brand new client account?
expected: Save your setup as a Snapshot and apply it to the new sub-account.

q: I want to resell the platform and mark up SMS costs — which plan do I need and what does it cost?
expected: SaaS Pro at $497 per month, which includes SaaS Mode and rebilling.

q: Does HighLevel integrate with Shopify to sync inventory?
expected: The documentation does not cover this.

q: What is HighLevel's uptime SLA percentage?
expected: The documentation does not cover this.
